sql.sql: select SNAP_DT, PRODUCT, count(*) n, count(distinct TRADE_ID) nt, sum(CURRENT_EXPOSURE) ce, sum(case when CURRENT_EXPOSURE<0 then 1 else 0 end) neg, sum(case when MTM_AMT<0 then 1 else 0 end) negmtm, sum(case when CURRENT_EXPOSURE is null then 1 else 0 end) nulls from dbo.CM_EXPOSURE group by SNAP_DT, PRODUCT order by SNAP_DT, PRODUCT

select ENTITY_TYP, count(*) n, count(CIF_REF) ncif, count(distinct CIF_REF) ndcif, min(len(CIF_REF)) minlen, max(len(CIF_REF)) maxlen, min(CIF_REF) mn, max(CIF_REF) mx from dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY group by ENTITY_TYP

select le.ENTITY_ID, le.ENTITY_NM, le.ENTITY_TYP, le.CIF_REF, count(*) trades, sum(c.CURRENT_EXPOSURE) ce, sum(c.MTM_AMT) mtm
from dbo.CM_EXPOSURE c join dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY le on le.ENTITY_ID=c.ENTITY_ID
where c.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30'
group by le.ENTITY_ID, le.ENTITY_NM, le.ENTITY_TYP, le.CIF_REF
having sum(c.CURRENT_EXPOSURE) > 5000000
order by ce desc

select count(*) n, sum(case when le.ENTITY_ID is null then 1 else 0 end) unmatched, (select count(*) from (select CIF_REF from dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY where CIF_REF is not null group by CIF_REF having count(*)>1) x) dupcif from dbo.CM_EXPOSURE c left join dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY le on le.ENTITY_ID=c.ENTITY_ID where c.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30'

select f.FACILITY_STATUS, f.PRODUCT_CD, count(*) n, count(b.FACILITY_ID) with_bal, sum(b.DRAWN_AMT) drawn, sum(b.UNDRAWN_AMT) undrawn, sum(f.COMMIT_AMT) commit
from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f left join BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b on b.FACILITY_ID=f.FACILITY_ID and b.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30'
group by 1,2 order by 1,2

select f.CIF_NO, f.FACILITY_STATUS, count(*) nfac, count(b.FACILITY_ID) nbal, sum(b.DRAWN_AMT) drawn, sum(b.UNDRAWN_AMT) undrawn, sum(f.COMMIT_AMT) commit, listagg(distinct f.PRODUCT_CD, ',') prods, max(f.RISK_RATING) maxrr, max(b.DPD) maxdpd
from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f left join BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b on b.FACILITY_ID=f.FACILITY_ID and b.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30'
where f.CIF_NO in ('0000041850','0000042498','0000041539','0000041642','0000042036','0000042083','0000042648','0000041002','0000042233','0000042657','0000042037','0000042452','0000041974','0000041022','0000041168')
group by 1,2 order by 1,2
